How to Play

Move: touch anywhere and drag — a joystick appears under your thumb.

On PC: move with WASD / arrow keys (or hold the left mouse button), Space jumps (just for fun), Esc pauses, 1–3 pick level-up cards. Gamepads work too. Install it from Chrome/Edge's address bar for a desktop window, or get the Windows app from the title screen. Full list: Controls.

Jump: press Space (gamepad A) to hop whenever you like — hold it to bunny-hop. Phones can turn on a ⤒ jump button in Audio & Settings. Jumping is just for fun: it never dodges or changes your hitbox.

Attack: automatic! Your hero strikes the nearest foes on their own.

Grow: every foe you slay feeds you its soul (XP) instantly. Level up, then pick 1 of 3 cards — new skills or stronger stats. Don't like the cards? Reroll them (1 per run, +1 every 5 levels). Maxed passives keep upgrading endlessly with diminishing returns. Your skills and passives show in the top-left corner.

Classes: nine classes (the hybrid Eclipse Paragon is unlocked with Shards), each with its own costume, skills and three Talent trees (T). Playing a class earns class XP → 1 talent point per class level (up to 51). Every 5 points in a tree unlocks its next tier; the 7th tier holds a build-defining capstone. Respec any time with Reset.

Gold & traders: foes sometimes drop gold coins ● (elites, bosses, chests and quests give more). Gold only lasts for the current run. Every few minutes a wandering trader appears for about a minute: follow the arrow and walk into them (or press E / gamepad X / the Trade button). The game pauses while you shop: the Merchant sells tonics and lessons, the Gambler rolls the bones, the Runesmith sharpens your skills, and a rare Mysterious Stranger offers pricey pacts.

Gear: elites and bosses drop treasure for 12 slots. Small upgrades equip themselves; Epic and Legendary finds open a compare card. At game over you may keep 1 item as a keepsake.

Survive: the danger meter climbs every few minutes — new foes, elite affixes, hordes, and a boss every 3 minutes.

Pause: tap the round ❚❚ button at the top right.

Shards ◆ are kept after each run — spend them in the Armory on permanent upgrades, classes and outfits.

Tip: add this page to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) for full-screen offline play.

Controls

MoveWASD or ↑←↓→ · or hold the left mouse button to walk toward the cursor · gamepad left stick / D-pad
Attack & skillsAutomatic. Every weapon and ability fires on its own (Druid forms and Mage Shimmerstep included), so no ability keys are needed
UltimateMax all six skills in a run to unlock your class Ultimate (Druid: one per form) · R · gamepad Y/△ · phones: the ✹ button · if you wait, it fires itself
JumpSpace hop any time in a run (hold to bunny-hop) · gamepad A/✕ · phones: optional ⤒ button (Audio & Settings). Just for fun: jumping never changes your position, hitbox or damage taken
Damage meterM show / hide the damage breakdown · or tap the ⚔ DPS button
Pause / resumeEsc or P · gamepad Start · the game also pauses itself when the window loses focus
Level-up cards123 pick (press again to take it) · ←→ cycle · Enter / Space choose · R reroll · gamepad D-pad + A, Y reroll
TradersWalk into a wandering trader, or press E / Enter near one · gamepad X/□ · phones: the Trade button. In the shop: 1–4 buy · ↑↓ + Enter · Esc / E leave · gamepad A buy, B leave
TreasureEnter / E equip · X salvage · gamepad A equip
Class select↑↓ choose a class · Enter on a locked class (e.g. Eclipse Paragon) buys it with Shards, otherwise starts the hunt · gamepad D-pad + A
MenusMouse click, scroll wheel on lists · Enter confirm / start · Esc back · gamepad A / B
ControllerXbox / PlayStation pads work on every screen: left stick or D-pad moves (and moves the yellow menu focus), A/✕ select, B/○ back, LB/RB switch tabs, Start pause, View/Select damage meter. Rumble can be turned off in Audio
Exit a runPause, then ⏏ Exit Run and confirm: you get the run summary and keep everything earned
ShortcutsT / Tab talents, G gear and C evolution codex (class select) · H this screen
Install: in Chrome or Edge use the address-bar Install icon (or menu, then Install Shadowfall) to play in its own window, offline too. Your progress is stored in this browser on this device; it doesn't sync with your phone.
